== Biography ==
'''Helen Glasgow''' was baptised at Linlithgow, West Lothian, on 22 Dec 1668. The parish register names her father as [[Glasgow-1105|John Glasgow]] and her mother as [[Eastone-3|Agnes Daston]].<ref name="FMP1"/> Because the entry records a baptism rather than a birth, her birth is placed before that date, and Linlithgow is inferred from the baptism rather than independently recorded.

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1105]] is assessed at 97% (proved). Helen's 22 December 1668 Linlithgow transcript names John Glasgow and Agnes Daston; the parallel entry gives Agnes Easton. The exact date, Linlithgow place and full John/Agnes couple correspond with the parallel Hellen-2458 account. Daston/Eastone is an indexed variant to check.

Confident record-father placement, probably for the same child represented by 2458; this rating does not assert two sisters or perform a merge.

Next useful test: Compare both transcripts with one original entry and the existing duplicate audit.
